description: How personality traits play out (TemperamentManager.gd): daily town scenes between adventurers, companion battle temperament, trait growth from experience, and voice lines by trait.

fields.name: scenes_per_day
fields.help: How many trait scenes can play each day among adventurers in town.

fields.name: trait_voice_share
fields.help: Chance a line comes from one of their traits instead of their archetype.

fields.name: talk_keep
fields.help: How many lines of Tavern talk are kept.

fields.name: battle
fields.help: Per trait: cowardly {freeze_below, chance}, loyal {protect_below}, kind {heal_below}, cautious {guard_below, chance}, reckless {never_guard}, cruel {finisher}, lazy {basic_chance}.

fields.name: growth
fields.help: Rules [{id, has?, lacks?, tag, count, chance, remove?, add?, news}]. Tags: rescuer, saved_by, near_death, boss_win, wronged, friend_died, passed_over, company_week, lost_spar, top_rank, taught, bullied.

fields.name: voice
fields.help: trait -> context -> [lines]. Contexts: greeting, chat, battle_start, victory, low_hp (also join, refuse, ally_down, gift_liked...).

fields.name: trait
fields.help: Trait that plays this scene (the actor).

fields.name: weight
fields.help: How often it's picked among the actor's scenes.

fields.name: headline
fields.help: Also put it in the town news (otherwise only in Tavern talk).

fields.name: news
fields.help: News line; placeholders like {actor}, {target} depend on the scene.

fields.name: affinity_caught
fields.help: Affinity of the mark toward the thief if caught.

fields.name: hangover_chance
fields.help: Chance the loser is out for a day.

fields.name: ledger_reach
fields.help: How many Ledger places above them they challenge.

fields.name: max_rapport
fields.help: Only if their rapport with you is at most this.

fields.name: recent_days
fields.help: How recent the death / occasion must be.

fields.name: respect_affinity
fields.help: A good loser's affinity toward the winner.

fields.name: sore_affinity
fields.help: A sore loser's affinity toward the winner.

fields.name: stand_up_traits
fields.help: Traits that may stand up for the victim.

fields.name: xp_per_level
fields.help: XP gained x the actor's level.

fields.name: below
fields.help: Mediate: only pairs at or below this affinity.
